benefitRows.description: Air travel accident insurance cover worth Rs 25 lakhs.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance benefit, report the incident to IDBI Bank Customer Care at 1800 425 7600 (Toll-Free) or 022 4042 6013 (Call Charges Applicable). For email support, contact idbicards@idbi.co.in. Ensure to report the incident promptly to avoid liability for any unauthorized transactions. For unauthorized transactions, email ccdisputes@idbi.co.in. You may also visit the nearest IDBI Bank branch for assistance. Please refer to the official IDBI Bank website for more details
